text.p: Directors of Exxon Corp Wednesday increased the big oil company's quarterly dividend 3.8 percent, declaring a cash payment of $0.41 per share on common, payable on June 10, shareholders of record May 13, the company said.
This is the second year in a row Exxon's board has raised the dividend at its April meeting. Last year, the payment was raised 5.3 percent to $0.79 a share from $0.75.
The quarterly payment $0.79 is equal to $0.395 on the shares outstanding since the company's two-for-one stock split which was effective last month, the company explained.
The company's statement offered no comment on the latest dividend increase, which followed the company's report of a 15 percent increase in first quarter profits early last week.
About two hours after the late morning dividend announcement, Exxon's stock was trading at 56-3/4, up one for the day, on total volume of nearly 2.5 million shares.
